headline: Chasing the balance FAIL uncovered a worse bug: the dedup exclusion list has never been honored by anything, because the key was built from Python's per-process-salted hash(). Fixed. Balance itself still FAILs and is proven unfixable post-hoc — the floor pins it.

the_bug_found_on_the_way.severity: HIGH — silently disabled a shipped quality stage for every domain on this path
the_bug_found_on_the_way.what: dedup_surfaces wrote exclusion keys as f'{file}:{line}:{hash(text) & 0xFFFFFFFF:08x}' and tokenize_corpus recomputed the same expression to decide what to drop from the training shard. Python salts str hashing per interpreter (PYTHONHASHSEED, on by default since 3.3), so writer and reader NEVER agreed.

evidence.path_line_prefix_overlap: 8063 of 8063 — the line numbers matched exactly; only the hash suffix differed, isolating the cause to the hash
evidence.two_interpreters_same_input: hash('abc') gave b164e0fc and 581830ea in separate processes

the_bug_found_on_the_way.blast_radius: tokenize_corpus.py:156 loads the list and prints 'honoring dedup exclusion list (N keys)', then drops nothing — every surface dedup believed it had culled went into the shard. This affects every domain that ran dedup_surfaces then tokenize, not just EDC.
the_bug_found_on_the_way.fix: One shared surface_key(file_name, line_index, text) using sha256, imported by tokenize_corpus from dedup_surfaces so a local copy cannot drift back apart.

red_green.test: test_surface_key_is_stable_across_processes — recomputes the key in SEPARATE interpreters under PYTHONHASHSEED 0/1/12345.
red_green.red: 3 distinct keys for identical input: relations.jsonl:7508:{c1c648e6, 4a1ac53a, 74e9cab1}
red_green.green: single key across all seeds; suite 5/5
red_green.note: An in-process test CANNOT catch this — the salt is fixed within one run. The subprocess form is the point.

balance_gate.verdict: STILL FAIL — and post-hoc culling provably cannot fix it
balance_gate.interpretation: Even measured on the effective corpus that actually ships, cov is 2.32 against a 1.0 ceiling. So the H7 verdict holds: this is a real corpus defect, not an artifact of the gate measuring the wrong population.
balance_gate.sharper_than_h7: H7 measured amplification as surfaces-per-TRIPLE and reported ~21x between the two big relations. Measured per SURFACED fact (what dedup actually groups on) the spread is 1368.78 to 6.90, ~198x, and the extremes sit on tiny fact sets — 9 facts producing 12319 surfaces. Both numbers are true of different denominators; this one is the one the culling machinery can see.

why_the_prescribed_fix_could_not_land_he.attempted: A per-relation per-fact emission budget derived from the corpus (median amplification), passed into dedup_unit.
why_the_prescribed_fix_could_not_land_he.reason_1_derivation_collapses: The budget is bounded by the existing flat cap: min(cap=60, ceil(median=271.42)) = 60 for every relation, i.e. identical to the current flat budget. Nothing changed; exclusions stayed at exactly 324128.
why_the_prescribed_fix_could_not_land_he.reason_2_the_floor_dominates: exposure_floor(n, cap) = max(2, min(cap, n//2, n)). With cap=60 any fact holding >=120 surfaces has floor 60, and target = max(floor, min(budget, n)) >= 60. Measured: n=120 -> floor 60, n=458 -> floor 60, n=1200 -> floor 60. No budget can push a heavily-amplified fact below 60 surfaces without breaking the under-exposure guarantee the floor exists to provide.
why_the_prescribed_fix_could_not_land_he.conclusion: Culling cannot rebalance a corpus whose imbalance lives above the floor. The lever is the GENERATOR emitting fewer surfaces per fact for over-amplified relations — exactly what H7 prescribed. Shipping an inert budget mechanism would have added dead complexity and the false impression that balance had been addressed.
why_the_prescribed_fix_could_not_land_he.what_was_NOT_done: dominance_max_frac / BALANCE_COV_MAX untouched at 1.0 (git-verified). The floor was briefly made budget-aware during the attempt, which broke an existing floor-protection test (n_after 2 vs expected >=5); that regression was caught by the suite and reverted rather than accommodated.

handoff.balance: Bound per-fact emission in the generator. EDC's hydrate is the Rust festival-factory driven by scripts/rehydrate_vc1.sh with BASE_N=8; the >1200 surfaces/fact relations (stage_production_character, stage_brand, stage_to_genre, recommendation, stage_rank_capacity — 9, 5, 9, 9 and 4 facts respectively) are where the corpus is being inflated. Re-hydration is a full-corpus provider spend, so it is a deliberate decision, not a side effect.
handoff.retokenize_warning: Any shard tokenized before this commit was built WITHOUT dedup applied, whatever its logs claimed. Shards must be rebuilt before their diversity properties can be trusted.

deviations: The briefed fix for 1a was implemented and then REVERTED after measurement showed it inert. Reported as a negative result with the arithmetic rather than shipped to look complete.
The session's headline change is a bug the brief did not ask about. It was found while instrumenting balance and is strictly more severe, so it was fixed first.
Only work item 1a is addressed. Items 1b, 2 and 3 are untouched — stopped at the context budget rather than rushing a gate-scoping change without its red cases.
No gate threshold was altered. The one gate-adjacent edit made during the attempt (a budget-aware floor) was a regression, was caught by the existing suite, and was reverted.

gates.dedup_suite: 5/5 PASS (2 new: cross-process key stability, same-line collision)

guard_addendum.why: 347934de fixed the salted-hash key, but tokenize still printed 'honoring dedup exclusion list (N keys)' — the same reassuring message that masked the bug for months. A stored count never compared to an applied count cannot detect its own lie, so the CLASS is now guarded rather than just the instance.
what_landed: tokenize_corpus reports APPLIED vs STORED per edition: '<unit>: dedup exclusions applied A/S stored'.
assert_dedup_exclusions_applied(): stored>0 AND applied==0 -> SystemExit (writer/reader key disagreement), naming the unit and the recovery action (re-run dedup_surfaces.py).
0 < applied < stored -> WARN with the delta printed; legitimate when the floor retired a fact or 25_hydrated changed after dedup ran.
stored==0 -> not a failure; the unit simply had nothing culled.

red_green.harness: scripts/pipeline/test_tokenize_dedup_guard.py — 5 cases, each run in a SEPARATE interpreter (the failure is a process-level SystemExit and tokenize_corpus imports transformers at module scope).
red_green.red: With the guard disabled, the exact months-long shape (stored 8063 / applied 0) returns PASSED.
red_green.green: 5/5; the broken shape exits closed and the message names both the unit and dedup_surfaces.py.

edc/las_vegas/2011.note: no exclusions stored — correctly not a failure
